reason: Normalizing map, not an enum table. The wire sends lowercase-kebab (`checked-in` per appointmentStatusSchema); mapAppointmentStatus uppercases and de-kebab-cases before lookup, so CHECKED_IN is the normalized form of a real wire value rather than a key that can never match.

Telemetry coverage is computed and reported, never persisted, so no Prisma enum can hold COMPLETE / GAPS_RECORDED / UNAVAILABLE. The map is annotated over the TelemetryCoverage state union (packages/types), which is this check's own recommended fix: a key that drifts from the wire union is a compile error.
